set.body:
Create a reusable surface backend conformance harness analogous to graphics renderer conformance. Every backend must report stable capabilities, accepted plan revision, mesh/layer resource events, bytes uploaded, draw calls, triangles, texture dimensions, cache hits, picks, and phase timings. Define exact semantic cases plus tolerant image cases for orientation, culling, depth, scalar/label/mask/RGBA layers, sparse fields, thresholds, blend order, lighting modes, bilateral layouts, and disposal.

Run the matrix for reference raster JVM/JS, JavaFX JVM, and Three.js Scala.js. Publish benchmark receipts for 32k and 164k meshes with 1/4/8 layers across cold load, camera-only motion, style update, layer-data update, timepoint update, pick, resize, and snapshot. Use pinned fixtures and hardware/browser/JDK metadata. Gate structural regressions exactly and timing regressions relative to recorded baselines rather than universal hardware-independent claims.

Acceptance: one command runs the focused matrix; CI runs deterministic semantics on both platforms; live JavaFX and browser jobs produce auditable JSON receipts; camera-only paths prove zero uploads; backend deviations are explicit capabilities or declared caveats, never silent semantic differences.
set.title: Surface renderer conformance and performance admission matrix
